job1.title: Full Stack Developer — Angular / Laravel
job1.desc: Nouara Platform — Telecom Eligibility, Billing & Operations Dashboard
job1.b1: Co-engineered and scaled Nouara, a mission-critical telecom platform (Angular 20 + Laravel 12 API), supporting daily operational workflows across billing, eligibility, and ticket tracking
job1.b2: Migrated ticket attachment storage to an S3-compatible RustFS instance, slashing infrastructure storage costs by ~35% and improving file upload/download speeds by 25%
job1.b3: Hardened platform authentication by implementing httpOnly JWT cookies with 2FA, eliminating XSS session-hijacking risks and ensuring compliance across sensitive telecom operations
job1.b4: Engineered an IQR-based real-time anomaly detection engine with automated Office365 SMTP alerts, reducing operational incident detection time from hours to under 2 minutes
job1.b5: Designed reactive Angular 20 administrative dashboards with optimized state management, reducing internal query times and manual data lookup effort by 40%

job2.title: AI Voice Translation Assistant for Telephony (Proof of Concept)
job2.desc: Real-Time AI-Powered Voice Translation Assistant for Telephony
job2.b1: Integrated Asterisk + FastAGI with a Flask/Python backend to route and process live telephony voice streams in real time, achieving sub-second pipeline latency (<800ms)
job2.b2: Evaluated and quantized a chained STT → Translation → TTS model pipeline using Hugging Face pre-trained models, optimizing inference speed by 30% without compromising translation accuracy
job2.b3: Prototyped end-to-end system integration between telephony infrastructure and AI inference services as a proof of concept, enabling concurrent handling of multiple live telephony streams

job4.title: Software Engineering Intern

rizz.title: Rizz — Real-Time Video Chat
rizz.desc: Architected a real-time WebRTC & Node.js video streaming monorepo, achieving peer-to-peer connection establishment in under 1.5s, with real-time peer matching, automated room moderation, and clean separation of concerns.
rizz.problem: Users needed a seamless way to connect face-to-face in real time without relying on third-party platforms.
rizz.solution: Built a full WebRTC & Node.js monorepo with real-time peer matching, automated room moderation, and clean architecture.
rizz.result: Peer-to-peer connections established in under 1.5 seconds with a smooth, reliable video experience.

castcue.title: Cast n Cue — Movie & TV Tracker
castcue.problem: Juggling a dozen shows at once means losing track of where you stopped, what airs next, and what's worth watching.
castcue.solution: Built an episode-level media tracker on Cloudflare Workers + D1 with TMDB/Trakt/TVmaze search, half-star ratings, private autosaved notes, watchlist roulette, and Google sign-in via Better Auth.
castcue.result: A private-by-design, free app that bookmarks movies, series, and episodes — so your watchlist and progress are always one click away.

leadgen.title: Lead Generation Landing Page
leadgen.desc: A minimal, high-performance lead capture landing page built with Astro 7, achieving a perfect Lighthouse score. Features Google Tag Manager, GA4, and Meta Pixel analytics events with event deduplication, Formspree serverless form backend, and a comprehensive CSS custom properties design system — all in ~10 KB total page weight.
leadgen.problem: Business landing pages are often bloated with JavaScript frameworks, hurting conversion rates through slow load times and poor Core Web Vitals.
leadgen.solution: Built a zero-JS-framework static landing page with Astro 7 SSG, inlining all CSS into a single HTML payload. Integrated a serverless form backend (Formspree) with client-side validation, loading states, and analytics event tracking (GTM → GA4 + Meta Pixel) with proper event deduplication.
leadgen.result: A 10.4 KB landing page with Lighthouse 100/100/100, 0ms TBT, 0 CLS, 1.6s LCP, and production-grade analytics — outperforming sites built with heavy frameworks.

ecom.title: E-Commerce Website — Full-Stack Storefront
ecom.problem: Running a real store means wiring catalog, cart, checkout, and fulfillment together — most templates stop at a static product grid.
ecom.solution: Built a complete commerce engine: Supabase-backed catalog, auth, storage and order lifecycle, Stripe Checkout, locally-persisted cart, verified-purchase reviews, trending rankings, admin order fulfillment, and shipping rules.
ecom.result: A single-system storefront where stock, reviews, payments, and fulfillment stay consistent from product page to delivered order.

budgetiq.title: BudgetIQ — AI Budget Planner
budgetiq.problem: Managing personal finances across salary, expenses, and assets is fragmented, and most tools offer no intelligent way to log spending.
budgetiq.solution: Built an open-source finance manager with Supabase auth, real-time dashboards, category charts, daily quotes, and a Gemini AI chatbot that parses natural language to suggest transactions.
budgetiq.result: A planner where chatting in plain language instantly captures expenses and income into an interactive dashboard.

trustless.title: TrustlessEscrow — Trust-Minimized Escrow
trustless.problem: Peer-to-peer trades rely on centralized intermediaries that hold funds and charge fees, introducing trust and custody risk.
trustless.solution: Engineered an on-chain escrow state machine in Solidity with deposit, delivery confirmation, disputes, and arbiter resolution, plus a wagmi/viem frontend deployed on Sepolia.
trustless.result: A fully auditable, fee-free escrow protocol where funds release only on confirmed delivery or arbiter decision.

crypto.title: Crypto & Stocks Dashboard
crypto.desc: A hybrid crypto + stock dashboard with real-time Binance WebSocket streaming, Yahoo Finance integration, TradingView-style charts (area/candlestick toggle), crowd-sourced 5-minute price predictions, browser-native price alerts, and a multi-provider AI chat assistant (7 free models + BYOK for OpenAI/Anthropic/Groq).
crypto.problem: Accessing real-time financial intelligence requires juggling multiple disjointed platforms with no unified view or AI-powered analysis. Most dashboards specialize in one asset class.
crypto.solution: Built a unified dashboard blending Binance WebSocket streams (crypto) with Yahoo Finance polling (stocks/ETFs) under a single data model, with TradingView-style charts, SWR-cached edge data fetching, 7 free built-in AI models plus BYOK (Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic), crowd-sourced prediction voting resolved every 5 minutes, and browser-native price alerts.
crypto.result: A single-pane-of-glass platform with near-zero latency updates from WebSocket streaming, chart type toggle (area/candlestick), multilingual AI assistant grounded in live market data, CSV export, and real-time crowd sentiment predictions.
